ModMetaData.name: Canopy Ghost for Better Trees
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Warning: this mod was written with AI coding tools (Claude Code).
An add-on for Better Trees. With its "Render trees over colonists" option on, a dense forest hides everyone in it; this mod shows pawns and items under a canopy as a translucent ghost through the leaves. Trees stay as they are; nothing switches on or off.
Notes - Works with any mod that draws trees over pawns; with vanilla tree layering it does nothing. Better Trees is not required. - Opacity, animals and items can be set in the mod settings. - Optional: hide Better Trees' cursor-transparency button (its hotkey keeps working). - Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.
